title: VTA Context DID-Template Render — payload
description: Render a context-scoped DID template to a DID document on a VTA. Gated on context access. The VTA fills `{TOKEN}` placeholders with caller-supplied variables plus ambient values it injects server-side. The success response is the rendered DID document.

contextId.description: The context the template is scoped to.

name.description: Resource id of the template to render within the context scope.

vars.description: Caller-supplied variables; the VTA also injects ambient VTA_DID, VTA_URL, NOW, CONTEXT_ID, and CONTEXT_DID (if set on the context) server-side.

Response.title: VTA Context DID-Template Render — response payload
Response.description: The rendered DID document with all placeholders filled.
